source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and DeepSeek identify DIMM/Memory, while the literal Procedure says to check Chassis information. Those domains have different members and fields and cannot share an implicit SPEC comparison.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The owner can normally clarify the copied-scope mismatch and provide the chosen matrix. Execution is gated, but both possible read-only workflows are understandable and recoverable.

engineering_decision_request.question: Resolve whether Functionality row 1623 validates DIMM/Memory as stated by Items and the DeepSeek resource, Chassis as stated by Procedure, or separately accepted checkpoints; define the authoritative collection/UI target, complete slot-or-member field matrix and disposition of the conflicting scope while preserving Master.

review_improvement: Makes the ignored DIMM-versus-Chassis mismatch auditable, prevents three fields from masquerading as complete inventory and defines the physical slot/member evidence needed after resolution.
independent_technical_reasoning: Memory inventory correctness depends on population topology: a capacity and part can be valid but assigned to the wrong socket/channel/slot or reported as a ghost member. Chassis inventory has entirely different topology. Because the resource graph changes with the source noun, scope resolution must precede any valid comparison.
